d.t: CLIP ON BASE EXTENDER FOR HEIGHT-ADJUSTABLE PEDESTAL FOR RAISED FLOORING
d.s: SikaRoof VersiJack Clip-on Extender is an attachment used at the base of adjustable pedestals to raise the height of pedestals by 10 mm in raised flooring systems. Extenders are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP) and it has four clips that twist-clip into the base of the adjustable pedestal. SikaRoof VersiJack Clip-on Extender is used in conjunction with SikaRoof VersiJack or SikaRoof VersiJack K pedestals. Extenders are typically used to correct for differences between design plans and site conditions, as opposed to going through the process of returning a particular pedestal model and reordering the correct pedestal height model.
a: Correct the difference between design plans and site conditions
Resistant to biological attack by moulds and algae
Chemically resistant to acids, alkalis, oils and soil chemicals
Operates within a wide service temperature range
us: Extenders are used with adjustable pedestals for raised flooring on podiums, balconies, roof terraces and areas with hardscape finishes.
